# Cao Yu (Cinematographer)

Cao Yu is a Chinese cinematographer who has worked in the film industry, though information about this particular Cao Yu should not be confused with the famous Chinese playwright of the same name (1910-1996).

## Notable Work

Cao Yu is perhaps best known for his cinematography on **"Long Day's Journey Into Night"** (地球最后的夜晚, 2018), directed by Bi Gan. This film gained significant international attention, particularly for its ambitious hour-long 3D single-take sequence. The film premiered at the Cannes Film Festival and showcased technically demanding and visually poetic cinematography.

He also worked with director Bi Gan on the earlier film **"Kaili Blues"** (路边野餐, 2015), which featured a remarkable 40-minute continuous shot and helped establish Bi Gan as an emerging auteur in Chinese cinema.

## Style

His work is characterized by long takes, dreamlike imagery, and atmospheric visual storytelling that complements Bi Gan's meditative and nonlinear narrative style.
